As I'm sure you'll agree, breakfast is one of my favorites in the world and I love trying new foods with my family every now and then. I went to this place today and was given a very bad decision by their staff - they cooked the food using eggs which I do not like as well as bacon because it tastes like pork rather than chicken (which my son has tried).

The breakfast in question is their 'Lemonade Bacon Chips' which are made with lemon juice, cream cheese and spices. The pancakes were really quite delicious but they did the whole thing wrong.
